column3: The Hebrew title is “Of David. A Maskil”; NASB sets “A Psalm of David. A Maskil” in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “reckons” is rendered “impute.”
NASB supplies “about my sin,” and renders “my bones” as “my body.”
“My juice was changed by the dry heat of summer” is rendered “My vitality was drained away as with the fever heat of summer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at a time of finding” is rendered “in a time when You may be found.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shouts of deliverance” is rendered “songs of deliverance.”
The Hebrew is compressed; NASB restructures it with “Whose trappings include bit and bridle” and “Otherwise they will not come near.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “pains” is rendered “sorrows.”
